title: Redemption Figure Calculation — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
**Recovery Desk calculation basis — the redemption figure, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

The redemption figure is the principal balance plus the fees due balance plus interest, rounded to the cent, where:

1. interest is the per diem times the days from the day after the interest-paid-to date through the good-through date;
2. the good-through date is the quote validity period for the tier after the quote date;
3. the per diem is the principal balance times the contract rate divided by the day basis for the tier, rounded to the cent.

The balances, the contract rate, the interest-paid-to date and the recovery type are read from the contract on the quote date.

**Order of assembly.** The end of the interest period is settled first; amounts are then added to or taken from the figure, and the figure is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

### Worked illustration (hypothetical contract)

Principal balance $10950.00, fees due $480.00, contract rate 10.00 percent, a 365-day basis, an illustrative quote validity period of 10 days, and an interest-paid-to date 25 days before the quote date. Per diem: $10950.00 times 10.00 percent is $1095.00 a year, divided by 365 is $3.00. Interest days: the 25 days through the quote date plus 10 days to the good-through date, 35 days; interest $105.00. Figure: $10950.00 plus $480.00 plus $105.00, that is $11535.00. Every input here is hypothetical.
